caption:
Momo loves sitting cross-legged on the floor, but lately both knees ache every time she gets up.

Sitting cross-legged keeps the knees deeply bent and twisted. Even very flexible people can feel achy when that position is held for a long time.

Hybi's reset: sit on a cushion to raise your hips, straighten and move your legs every 20–30 minutes, do straight-leg thigh squeezes (5 seconds × 10) and 10 sit-to-stands from a chair.

Swelling, locking, giving way or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐱
